original_card.question: Can a template or call contract leave two or more unpaid coordinates per live family?
methods: State a replacement for the coverage identity (mass = 72W + 64N) and the contract change that realizes it, with its implementation cost.
Find an obstruction: show which data-endpoint obligation forces exactly one unpaid coordinate in the current template.
original_card.acceptance_gate: An explicit replacement identity, verified on a small complete instance with dirty inputs, priced with ceiling.ceiling(unpaid=...).

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Explain where the single unpaid coordinate per family comes from in the hosted template; propose one change and price it. Ideal budget: two unpaid coordinates per family is 3.77x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: The deficit is one coordinate per family minus the centre charge; doubling unpaid coordinates per family scales it directly.
allowed_variations: One template change or one endpoint-contract change.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Counting a coordinate as unpaid while leaving it unadvanced in the data endpoint.

actual_scope: Construct one exact five-dimensional port decoder for the selected 112 labels in F2^9: partition them into 22 orthogonal five-frames plus one orthogonal pair, solve the block identity, factor it into charged B14 support terms, and screen the u=5 local profile.
scope_change_reason: Changed the endpoint contract from line/plane/three-plane ports to five-dimensional ports and changed the object from a prior matched or tri-plane decoder to a five-frame cover of the selected F2^9 labels. The bounded method uses seeded randomized greedy incidence construction followed by an exact F2 block solve and support-rank factorization.
bottleneck_link: Five unpaid coordinates increase the local deficit per live family. The exact five-frame decoder costs 118 copied-rank units and has a favorable selected-word moment screen, subject to a priced physical route and endpoint implementation.
stop_rule: Enumerate all selected-label five-frames, then run the seed-fixed randomized greedy cover for at most 10,000 attempts. Stop at the first full cover whose deterministic block solve factors into positive-charge terms and passes the exact a=1/99 u=5 local screen; do not optimize beyond the first accepted cover. The run stops at attempt 365. No supplier or kappa claim without all remaining interface costs.
evidence: CANDIDATE.json stores the 22 five-frames, residual pair, 23 F2 coefficient matrices and 16 rank-one support terms. The verified copy-rank histogram is {7:10,8:6}, charge 118. Exact replay checks the full 112x112 decoder, 11,776 C_E^2 address-basis cases and 672 dirty-input endpoint cases. Under the changed u=5 moment relaxation, a=1/99 passes; all other implementation overhead must fit within 157 additional rank-one-equivalent units, or 134 after provisionally charging one unit for each of 23 aggregate translations. No physical supplier or kappa is established.
